objective: Refactor the Volocal audio pipeline and LLM backend to achieve low-latency, real-time bidirectional Thai translation by mirroring the FluidInference architecture.

tasks.title: Voice Activity Detection (VAD) as an Execution Gate
tasks.problem_statement: SharedAudioEngine acts as an unmetered firehose, pushing every buffer to the ASR provider. This causes Whisper/Parakeet to transcribe background noise, leading to hallucinations and CPU/GPU thermal throttling.
tasks.fluid_pattern: swift-scribe and FluidAudio use Silero VAD as an absolute gatekeeper for ASR execution.
implementation_instructions: Modify the audio capture closure to evaluate `VadManager.isSpeaking`.
Only append audio samples to the ASR provider if `isSpeaking == true`.

Implement a deterministic trigger: when `isSpeaking` drops to `false` for a continuous 600ms threshold, immediately execute `handleEndOfUtterance()` instead of waiting for the STT engine to detect it.

tasks.title: ANE Offloading via CoreML
tasks.problem_statement: LLMManager relies on llama.cpp to run .gguf files, creating severe CPU/GPU bottlenecks when running concurrently with WhisperKit, resulting in battery drain and UI stutter.
tasks.fluid_pattern: FluidInference lab strictly uses Apple Neural Engine (ANE) optimized models via .mlpackage formats to eliminate GPU contention.
implementation_instructions: Utilize FluidInference/mobius or Apple's coremltools to convert the Qwen0.8B fallback model from .gguf to .mlpackage.
Implement a new LLMProvider that utilizes the CoreML framework to execute the .mlpackage natively on the ANE.
Update the download registry to fetch the CoreML variant instead of the GGUF.

tasks.title: Speaker Diarization (Contextual Routing)
tasks.problem_statement: In a bidirectional translation environment, speaking English to the target while the Thai STT model is active causes the model to process English as Thai phonetics, corrupting the LLM context.
tasks.fluid_pattern: FluidAudio utilizes Speaker Diarization to tag and filter incoming audio chunks by speaker ID in real-time.
implementation_instructions: Implement FluidAudio's speaker diarization module within the audio pipeline.
Tag incoming audio chunks with a Speaker ID (e.g., Speaker 0 for Device Owner, Speaker 1 for Target).
Add a routing check: silently discard chunks tagged as Speaker 0 (English owner) and only forward Speaker 1's audio to the Whisper Thai ASR pipeline.

tasks.title: Sliding Window Audio Buffers
tasks.problem_statement: Whisper models require a fixed 30-second context window. Continuous speech beyond this duration causes the pipeline to infinitely append float arrays, leading to truncation or crashes.
tasks.fluid_pattern: swift-scribe manages continuous streaming transcription by employing sliding context windows.
implementation_instructions: Create an `AudioContext` manager within the pipeline.
Upon the VAD triggering `handleEndOfUtterance()`, explicitly flush and destroy the accumulated `[Float]` array.
Ensure Whisper receives a completely clean, zeroed 30-second window for every new segmented sentence.
